note: Every feed was opened and parsed before it was added. First-party means the organisation, the person or the project publishes it themselves; an outlet is here only when it is recognised in its field. Nothing in this file authorises a logo, a wordmark or a quote: see docs/adr/0010-real-names-and-live-content.md.
